expectations.text: Flags domain/label-policy.ts for importing drizzle-orm / the db schema into the domain layer
expectations.evidence: Findings #1-#2: 'Imports drizzle-orm... which must contain pure business rules' and 'Imports server/src/db/schema.js... pulling a concrete persistence schema into the domain layer'

expectations.text: Flags application/use-cases/create-label.ts for importing a Fastify type into the application layer
expectations.evidence: Not mentioned anywhere in the 7 findings. The with-skill run focused entirely on the domain/drizzle and routes/db-bypass violations and never flagged create-label.ts importing FastifyRequest.

expectations.text: Flags adapters/inbound/http/labels.routes.ts for querying the database directly instead of calling a use case
expectations.evidence: Finding #4: 'The GET handler runs db.select().from(labels)... bypassing the application use-case and outbound persistence layers entirely'

eval_feedback.overall: Surprising miss: the with-skill run caught 2/3 planted violations but missed the FastifyRequest import in create-label.ts entirely, even though the SKILL.md explicitly lists 'domain/application imports from Fastify' as forbidden. The without-skill baseline caught this one. Worth re-running at a higher sample size before concluding this is systematic.
